title: Professional licence register
description: Record professional licence decisions and review corrections to recorded activities and conditions.

review.description: A distinct reviewer approves correction of recorded professional activities and conditions. Approval leaves the licence unchanged until manual application of both frozen values.

scopeNotes: Person, regulator and jurisdiction URIs are inert external references. No lookup, identity validation or duplication of external masters occurs.
This register records dated licence facts. It issues no credential and makes no automatic determination of current legal permission to practise.
Profession and status codes are fixed synthetic examples. Readers see only profession, jurisdiction, recorded status and validity dates.
